title: Streamliner Plugin Role Skills
summary: Wave 1 is detailed with local specs for stable role identifiers, launch-policy-v1, and the first repository-installable role-skills slice. Later waves sketch explicit launch contexts, marketplace migration, trust remediation, second-builder validation, and artifact-root adoption.

nodes.title: Stable role identifiers and contracts
nodes.summary: Define the public versioned role IDs, skill names, authority layers, explicit activation rules, and Actor Fabric binding vocabulary that form the early role-context-v1 export.

nodes.title: Launch policy contract foundation
nodes.summary: Define launch-policy-v1: typed schema, non-overridable policy versus defaults, precedence and merge behavior, compatibility and provenance semantics, and automated versus interactive failure behavior.

nodes.title: Repository role skills slice
nodes.summary: Package Streamliner Core, orientation, Designer, Formation, Orchestrator, Node Worker, Node Implementer, and Node Reviewer skills in the canonical plugin and make the first role-context-v1 slice installable from the repository marketplace.

nodes.title: Role context v1 gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates the role contracts, repository-installed plugin skills, explicit activation behavior, documentation authority boundaries, and the early role-ID export before launch integrations are promoted.

nodes.title: Worker role launch integration
nodes.summary: Compose explicit Node Worker, Node Implementer, and Node Reviewer role contracts into terminal and managed SDK launch paths while keeping generated context.md node-specific and launch prompts thin.

externalDependsOn.label: Artifact Sync exports artifact-operations-v1 revision semantics

nodes.title: Short implementer and reviewer launch test
nodes.summary: Validate short composed launches for Node Implementer and Node Reviewer across supported launch paths, including authority, outcome-anchor, field-report, real-review, and lifecycle-policy boundaries without copied long-form prompts.

nodes.title: Orchestrator launch context contract
nodes.summary: Define orchestrator-launch-context-v1 with explicit role/version, project/workstream identity, artifact provider and opaque revision (plus optional local path/Git provenance), current brief/graph state, pending Telex thread references, actor binding, and unresolved actions for Actor Fabric assembly.

externalDependsOn.label: Artifact Sync exports accepted artifact-operations-v1 revision semantics

nodes.title: Orchestrator launch context v1 test
nodes.summary: Validate that Actor Fabric can assemble a current replacement orchestrator package from versioned role context, artifact provenance, Telex references, binding state, and unresolved actions without a generic-session briefing step.

nodes.title: Marketplace identity migration
nodes.summary: Migrate to canonical streamliner@streamliner while preserving temporary streamliner@streamliner-local compatibility across marketplace registration, enabled settings, installed caches, and launch preflight.

nodes.title: Marketplace migration test
nodes.summary: Validate clean canonical installation, temporary legacy compatibility, settings/cache migration, launch preflight behavior, upgrade, rollback, and removal without stranding sessions.

nodes.title: Trust and compatibility remediation
nodes.summary: Implement contract and policy validation, provenance diagnostics, automated-launch blocking, and explicit warned interactive overrides for missing, stale, untrusted, or incompatible inputs.

nodes.title: Trust and compatibility test
nodes.summary: Exercise supported contract versions, missing or invalid required policy, stale or untrusted provenance, automated blocking, and explicit interactive override diagnostics without silent degradation.

nodes.title: Second-builder role delivery gate
nodes.summary: A second builder installs the canonical plugin and exercises explicit Designer, Formation, Orchestrator, Node Implementer, and Node Reviewer roles with trustworthy policy handling and no private briefing or copied prompt profile.

nodes.title: Artifact operations and shared policy adoption
nodes.summary: Consume artifact-root-v1 and artifact-operations-v1 so role and launch-policy resolution uses shared artifact snapshots, storage-neutral revisions, canonical API mutations, and provenance without changing logical role IDs, policy semantics, or builder-local prompt profiles.

externalDependsOn.label: artifact-root-v1 from Git-backed Artifact Ledger and Sync
artifact-operations-v1 from Git-backed Artifact Ledger and Sync

nodes.title: Plugin role skills closure gate
nodes.summary: Validate role delivery, launch-policy ownership, marketplace and trust behavior, orchestrator context export, artifact-root adoption, and availability of evidence for the campaign gate without duplicating the integrated campaign exercise.

checkpoints.title: Stable role identifiers available
checkpoints.summary: Versioned role IDs, skill names, scope vocabulary, and binding metadata are stable enough to unblock Actor Fabric Wave 1.

checkpoints.title: Role context v1 available
checkpoints.summary: The repository-installed plugin delivers the approved explicit role contracts and launch-policy foundation.

checkpoints.title: Worker role launches proven
checkpoints.summary: Node Implementer and Node Reviewer can be launched from short composed instructions without duplicating stable role or lifecycle guidance.

checkpoints.title: Orchestrator launch context available
checkpoints.summary: orchestrator-launch-context-v1 is validated and available for Actor Fabric's bound-orchestrator UI completion.

checkpoints.title: Marketplace migration validated
checkpoints.summary: Canonical plugin installation and temporary legacy compatibility work across settings, cache, preflight, upgrade, rollback, and removal.

checkpoints.title: Trust and compatibility validated
checkpoints.summary: Role and policy contracts fail or remediate predictably for missing, stale, untrusted, and incompatible inputs.

checkpoints.title: Second-builder role delivery proven
checkpoints.summary: The role-focused workstream gate has passed in a separate builder environment.

checkpoints.title: Artifact root policy adopted
checkpoints.summary: Role and shared policy discovery consume artifact-root-v1 and artifact-operations-v1 while preserving contract semantics and local profile separation.

checkpoints.title: Plugin role skills closure ready
checkpoints.summary: All role, policy, marketplace, compatibility, orchestrator-context, and artifact-root obligations are validated and their evidence is available to the campaign gate.
